structural_confirmation_note: Unlike ablation 1/2, this ablation does not bypass a call site at the ProtosActivation.lookup level in a way that removes a distinguishable frame (readLocalSlot's own fully-qualified name is still called somewhere in both variants); java.util.LinkedHashMap.containsKey/get are also simple enough to be inlined by the JIT and are not a reliable JFR-sampled-frame signal. Structural confirmation instead reads the exact patched (or, for baseline, unmodified) source tree the image was built from (/opt/protos-source), scoped per-method/per-file, and proves both what changed and what stayed on the baseline path: (1) ProtosObjectValue.readLocalSlot's own method body is byte-for-byte identical between baseline and ablation; (2) a new readLocalSlotSingleProbe helper exists only in the ablation image, with the diagnostic marker comment, no containsKey, and exactly one get(name); (3) ProtosActivation.lookup calls the diagnostic helper at exactly its two lexical call sites in the ablation image and calls ordinary readLocalSlot at those same two call sites in the baseline image; (4) the captured-lexical-context traversal loop is present, unchanged, in both; (5) ProtosValueLookup's receiver/delegation member-lookup call site still calls ordinary readLocalSlot in both images. This is one per-image confirmation, not repeated independently per workload.
